The premier non-Genocide spot in this part of HCMC! Vey helpful 🇿🇦🇵🇸🇪🇸🇳🇴 staff!
Dec 2024 • Solo
The 🇵🇸🧕🏼 café attached to the bistro is called Kafka Café ⚖️🔻 and is located on the ground floor, although the fair-sized restrooms themselves are up on the 3rd floor, above a yoga boutique I believe 🕌 . The café itself is located down a short cul-de-sac, close to a corner of a standard block. It's a 🇿🇦 great and 🇵🇸 friendly choice for doing a bit of working, or studying of a Middle Eastern language - whether an 🇱🇧Arabic dialect or 🇮🇷 Persian. There's a long bench further back on the ground floor, which affords a great view of chefs prepping food and stock checking. If you're cruelty-free, you'll be elated to know that there is an option for 🌳 oat milk with your drinks order, and you're also able to specify the number of espresso shots you'd like. There don't seem to be many - if any - options (food-wise) in the café. If you do calves' milk there's stuff.

Vegetarian restaurant where East meets West
Nov 2021 • Friends
I was invited by my close friend for dinner at this restaurant. When I first came there, he chose a floor-seating table and we sat down on cushions. That made me feel like somewhere like home but special. He ordered some signature dishes which are culinary combinations of the East and the Western ingredients. The foods took me to several levels of taste like I was traveling to Italia when it came to burrata cheese then I moved to one tropical country for a bite of sour sweet orange. I would love to try more in the next times.

a hidden delight!
Jan 2021 • Solo
I came upon Prem only through a TripAdvisor search after walking past it several times. the street signage could be improved hehe! 

but, once inside, one is greeted with smiling and friendly staff, some fine tunes, a lovely boutique garden, and lovely decor. the rush of Sài Gon just disappears! 

I had the special onion cashew soup which was lovely, with a great fresh juice. both nice. I haven't tried the coffee,. next time!

strongly recommend a visit here. this meat lover loved this lil' vegetarian gem! (oh and you must check out the photo/quotation collage, one of the most beautiful and touching I've seen).

Loads of delicious menu choices
Dec 2019
Had a delicious vegan korma here, along with the Green Dragon Vegan Blend smoothie which I ordered without ice (and which came out great, imo). On another visit I ordered the eggplant rolls which were supertasty. I also got the same smoothie as before, but they forgot my request for no straw. When I removed the straw, a different-colored smoothie oozed out, which tells me it hadn’t been cleaned from the last customer. (Yuck.) So minus one star for the hygiene fail. 

Service is friendly and atmosphere is pleasant. They have some outdoor seating on a garden balcony of sorts, an indoor-ish space which is open to the balcony, and an air-conditioned indoor space where you take off your shoes and sit on the floor. Secure wifi, credit cards accepted.

One of it's kind!
Sep 2019 • Family
It's a nice place to try out as it has an extensive menu, though little on the pricier side. Our order came fast and was quiet yummy. Although there was no homemade cardamom ice cream and we told while we ordered that it would be replaced with vanilla. The cafe below the bistro itself is quite nice, the coffee is nice and the cakes are fresh . I would recommend them to keep some eggless cakes too in the principal of true vegetarianism. Also I think the rest room could use some refurbishing, given it's a unisex one. Overall it's a one of kind concept store, the outside sitting area is really pretty and can be enjoyed on a pleasant evening. Will do again!

Awesome veggi restaurant so much choice
Aug 2019 • Couples
We had dinner at prem bistro tonight and it was amazing! My partner found the restaurant mentioned on a website online and for our last night in Saigon we decided to head over there even though it was 8.30pm and we saw they close at 9pm. We werent rushed at all and were given plentu of time to choose from the huge menu. Your hardest decision will be what to have as theres so many awesome dishes to pick from. Its a lovely restaurant with cool travel photos and quotes on the wall ( which we found out were from the owners travels) with a nice outdoor area, indoor area and chill seating area. The staff were so helpful especially my-my who went out of her way to chat to us, recommend dishes, check our food was good and tell us about the restaurant and owner. I had the prem bowl which was unreal and my partner had masala chickpeas which were super tasty
 We shared two staters the eggppant rolls and chickpea battered with mango dip botj were amazing. I wish we couldve had desert but we were just too full. I cant fault this place and wish we had found it sooner, its so good to find somewhere fully vegetarian without a hint of fish sauce in sight!! We walked back to D1 from the restaurant in about 15 mins so the location is also great. Thanks so much highly recommend you give it a try.
